name: dsh-openrouter-plus
description: OpenRouter service-tier routing for DeepSeek Harness — a loopback relay that applies a service tier (flex / priority / fast / ultrafast) to each Session at request time, a live status API, and an OpenRouter Plus settings page that points one provider row at the relay and stores a default tier.

scripts.check: node --check index.js && node --check client.js && node --check lib/proxy.js && node --check lib/metrics.js && node --check lib/config-bridge.js && node --check lib/reasoning.js
